description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Buff Fire 30% (15s)], [Buff Water 30% (15s)], [Buff Wind 30% (15s)], [Buff Earth 30% (15s)], [Awoken Spellblade], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Barrage Master Follow-Up] to the user

description.text: Spellblade abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.text: Casts Barrage Master after using two Wind, Water, Fire or Earth abilities
